articles.title: Explosions rock Damascus on second day of Macron's visit to Syria
articles.summary: Explosions near a hotel in Damascus wounded at least 18 people during French President Macron's visit to Syria for talks with Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa.

articles.title: Macron lands in Syria in first post-Assad visit by Western head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived in Damascus on Monday alongside a business delegation in the first visit by a Western European head of state since Bashar al-Assad's 2024 ousting.
